newsitem.title: ITALY: Unions in Italy metalworkers' dispute meet tonight.
newsitem.headline: Unions in Italy metalworkers' dispute meet tonight.

text.p: Union leaders of Italy's engineers and metalworkers will meet later on Wednesday to assess progress in talks with employers over a protracted pay dispute.

Union sources said leaders of the FIM, FIOM and UILM unions would meet leaders of the union umbrella groups CIGL, CISL and UIL at 1700 GMT, and that full negotiations with the employers' group Federmeccanica would probably continue on Thursday.
Talks resumed on Monday for the first time in more than a month to try to end the pay dispute which involves some 1.7 million workers. The sector's two-year contract expired in June.

CSIL secretary Natale Forlani, in a statement, said "common sense" was needed to find a solution, noting that wage inflation in 1996 had increased 4.1 percent against an overall inflation rate of 3.9 percent.
"The directions for possible solutions have been set," he said. "Now all we need is good sense to find the equilibrium between the positions expressed by the two sides."
